title: The Riemann Proof, Rebuilt: 17M Lines, 114,019 Jobs, 0 Errors
description:
A technical replay of the 17-million-line Lean 4 formalization of the Riemann Hypothesis.

This is not a new proof. It is a replay and consolidation of the public archive: 47,885 modules, 14,583,569 lines, 494,947 parsed imports. The build is green at commit e497a6603e: 114,019 jobs, 9 h 07 m, 0 errors. Proof certification (comparator, con-leche, leanchecker) is still in progress.
